integrity: The infinite-family proof is self-contained, while the exhaustive and seeded finite computations are supplementary; historical originality and independent mathematical validation remain unconfirmed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty simple graphs with equal clique and chromatic numbers only. No converse characterization and no claim for arbitrary unequal-invariant graphs. The closest primary paper’s full remanent-language section was inaccessible for priority checking; only abstract and introductory material were inspected.
title: Clique–chromatic collapse of remanent graph languages
